correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact two-round EF criterion for the restricted relational language {0,R(x,y,z):x+y=z}: equality of the sets of all pointed one-step atomic-diagram profiles P_G(x). Every pair diagram on {0,x,y} reduces to eight predicates x=0,y=0,x=y,2x=0,2y=0,x+y=0,2x=y,2y=x; no nested binary-function terms occur. Using {0,x,-x,2x}, doubling fibres of size 2^r and generic involution/non-involution witnesses, verified the seven pointed types Z,I+/-,IV+/-,L+/- and their occurrence in terms of r=#cyclic summands, t=#order≥4, u=#order≥8, v=#order≥16. These all-exponent conditions give exactly 15 complete signature sets. Independently enumerated all actual pair diagrams for the 15 finite canonical representative groups, checked pairwise distinct signatures and C16 versus C32 equivalence; the retrieved profile_table.json agrees. The last class requires two factors of order at least eight and one of at least sixteen, so minimal order is 8*16=128. Finite signatures corroborate the all-parameter category/fibre proof.
